CODE = 'VAT.INVOICE_KIND' AND aih.invoice_kind = v.code_value ) invoice_kind_n, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'VAT.BILLING_WAY' AND aih.billing_way = v.code_value ) billing_way_n, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'VAT.INVOICE_CONFIRM_STATUS' AND aih.confirm_status = v.code_value ) confirm_status_n, ( SELECT su.user_name FROM sys_user su WHERE su.user_id = aih.created_by ) created_by, ( SELECT fc.currency_name FROM fnd_currency fc WHERE fc.currency_code = aih.currency ) currency_n, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'HLS211_TAXPAYER_TYPE' AND hbm.taxpayer_type = v.code_value ) taxpayer_type_n from acr_invoice_hd aih left join hls_bp_master hbm on hbm.bp_id = aih.bp_id where aih.invoice_hd_id = #{invoiceHdId}

CODE = 'VAT.INVOICE_KIND' AND aih.invoice_kind = v.code_value ) invoice_kind_n, ( SELECT su.description FROM sys_user su WHERE su.user_id = aih.created_by ) created_by_n, (SELECT wm_concat(distinct fc.company_full_name) FROM acr_invoice_ln ln, acr_invoice_ln_dt dt, con_contract_cashflow ccc, con_contract cc, fnd_company fc WHERE ln.invoice_ln_id = dt.invoice_ln_id AND dt.cashflow_id = ccc.cashflow_id AND ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id AND cc.company_id = fc.company_id AND ln.invoice_hd_id = aih.invoice_hd_id) as company_full_name from acr_invoice_hd aih left join hls_bp_master hbm on hbm.bp_id = aih.bp_id where aih.invoice_hd_id = #{invoiceHdId}

SELECT nvl(t2.normalCount,0), nvl(t2.specialCount,0), nvl(ROUND(t2.normalCount/(t2.normalCount + t2.specialCount),8),0) AS radio FROM ( SELECT ( SELECT t1.kindCount FROM ( SELECT aih.invoice_kind, count(invoice_kind) AS kindCount FROM acp_invoice_hd aih, acp_invoice_ln ail WHERE aih.invoice_hd_id = ail.invoice_hd_id GROUP BY aih.invoice_kind ) t1 WHERE t1.invoice_kind = 0 ) AS normalCount, ( SELECT t1.kindCount FROM ( SELECT aih.invoice_kind, count(invoice_kind) AS kindCount FROM acp_invoice_hd aih, acp_invoice_ln ail WHERE aih.invoice_hd_id = ail.invoice_hd_id GROUP BY aih.invoice_kind ) t1 WHERE t1.invoice_kind = 2 ) AS specialCount FROM DUAL ) t2

SELECT ccc.cashflow_id, ccc.contract_id, cc.contract_name, cc.contract_number, hbm.bp_name, hbm.bp_id, ccc.times, ccc.due_date, ccc.due_amount, ccc.received_amount, ccc.billing_principal, ccc.cf_item, hci.description AS cfItemDesc, hdc.description AS projectDesc, cc.document_category, cc.company_id FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc, con_contract cc, hls_cashflow_item hci, hls_bp_master hbm, hls_document_category hdc WHERE ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id AND hdc.document_category = cc.document_category AND cc.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND ccc.cf_direction = 'INFLOW' AND hbm.bp_id = cc.tenant_id AND hci.cf_item = ccc.cf_item AND hci.cf_type = ccc.cf_type AND ccc.cf_item = 51 AND ccc.write_off_flag = 'FULL' AND nvl(ccc.due_amount,0) > nvl(ccc.billing_amount,0)
and cc.contract_name LIKE concat('%', #{contractName}, '%')
and cc.contract_number LIKE concat('%', #{contractNumber}, '%')
and to_days(ccc.due_date) BETWEEN to_days(#{dueDateFrom}) AND to_days(#{dueDateTo})
and hbm.bp_name LIKE concat('%', #{bpName}, '%')
and hdc.description LIKE concat('%', #{projectDesc}, '%')
UNION SELECT fqc.quotation_cashflow_id AS cashflow_id, fc.contract_id, fc.contract_name, fc.contract_number, hbm.bp_name, hbm.bp_id, fqc.times, fqc.due_date, fqc.due_amount, fqc.received_amount, fqc.billing_amount AS billing_principal, fqc.cf_item, hci.description AS cfItemDesc, hdc.description AS projectDesc, fc.document_category, fc.company_id FROM fct_quotation_cashflow fqc, fct_contract fc, hls_cashflow_item hci, hls_bp_master hbm, fct_project_bp fpb, hls_document_category hdc WHERE fqc.contract_id = fc.contract_id AND hdc.document_category = fc.document_category AND fc.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND fpb.project_id = fc.project_id AND fqc.cf_direction = 'INFLOW' AND fpb.credit_grantor_party = 'Y' AND hbm.bp_id = fpb.bp_id AND hci.cf_item = fqc.cf_item AND hci.cf_type = fqc.cf_type AND fqc.cf_item = 51 AND fqc.write_off_flag = 'FULL' AND nvl(fqc.due_amount,0) > nvl(fqc.billing_amount,0)
and fc.contract_name LIKE concat('%', #{contractName}, '%')
and fc.contract_number LIKE concat('%', #{contractNumber}, '%')
and to_days(fqc.due_date) BETWEEN to_days(#{dueDateFrom}) AND to_days(#{dueDateTo})
and hbm.bp_name LIKE concat('%', #{bpName}, '%')
and hdc.description LIKE concat('%', #{projectDesc}, '%')

select tab.* from (SELECT ccc.cashflow_id, ccc.contract_id, cc.contract_name, cc.contract_number, hbm.bp_name, hbm.bp_id, ccc.times, ccc.due_date, (case when ccc.cf_item=1 then ccc.principal when ccc.cf_item=2 then ccc.due_amount else 0 end) as due_amount, ccc.received_principal as received_amount, ccc.billing_principal, ccc.cf_item, (case when ccc.cf_item=1 then '回租本金' when ccc.cf_item=2 then '回租首付款' else '' end) as cfItemDesc, hdc.description AS projectDesc, cc.document_category, cc.company_id, (case when ccc.cf_item=1 then '本金' when ccc.cf_item=2 then '首付款' else '' end) as document_resource, '' as contract_content_number, (select arl.RECEIPT_LN_ID from ACR_RECEIPT_LN arl where arl.SOURCE_ID = ccc.CASHFLOW_ID and arl.SOURCE_TYPE = 'CON_CONTRACT') RECEIPT_LN_ID, nvl((select '已打印' from ACR_RECEIPT_LN arl, ACR_RECEIPT_Hd arh where arl.RECEIPT_HD_ID = arh.RECEIPT_HD_ID and arl.SOURCE_ID = ccc.CASHFLOW_ID and arl.SOURCE_TYPE = 'CON_CONTRACT'),'未打印') as receipt_status_desc
FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc, con_contract cc, hls_bp_master hbm, hls_document_category hdc WHERE ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id AND hdc.document_category = cc.document_category AND cc.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND cc.business_type = 'LEASEBACK' AND hbm.bp_id = cc.tenant_id AND ((ccc.cf_item = 1 and nvl(ccc.principal, 0) > nvl(ccc.billing_principal, 0)) or (ccc.cf_item=2 and nvl(ccc.due_amount, 0) > nvl(ccc.billing_amount, 0))) UNION SELECT fqc.quotation_cashflow_id AS cashflow_id, fc.contract_id, fc.contract_name, fc.contract_number, principal.bp_name, principal.bp_id, fqc.times, fqc.due_date, fqc.due_amount, fqc.received_amount, fqc.billing_amount AS billing_principal, fqc.cf_item, hci.description AS cfItemDesc, hdc.description AS projectDesc, fc.document_category, fc.company_id, '本金' AS document_resource, ( SELECT f.approval_number FROM fct_project f WHERE f.project_id = fc.PROJECT_ID ) AS contract_content_number, ( SELECT arl.RECEIPT_LN_ID FROM ACR_RECEIPT_LN arl WHERE arl.SOURCE_ID = fqc.QUOTATION_CASHFLOW_ID AND arl.SOURCE_TYPE = 'FCT_CONTRACT') RECEIPT_LN_ID, nvl( ( SELECT '已打印' FROM ACR_RECEIPT_LN arl, ACR_RECEIPT_Hd arh WHERE arl.RECEIPT_HD_ID = arh.RECEIPT_HD_ID AND arl.SOURCE_ID = fqc.QUOTATION_CASHFLOW_ID AND arl.SOURCE_TYPE = 'FCT_CONTRACT'),'未打印') AS receipt_status_desc FROM fct_quotation_cashflow fqc JOIN fct_contract fc ON fqc.contract_id = fc.contract_id JOIN hls_cashflow_item hci ON hci.cf_item = fqc.cf_item AND hci.cf_type= fqc.cf_type JOIN hls_document_category hdc ON hdc.document_category = fc.document_category LEFT JOIN ( SELECT hbm.bp_id, hbm.bp_name, fpb.project_id FROM fct_project_bp fpb JOIN hls_bp_master hbm ON fpb.bp_id= hbm.bp_id WHERE fpb.principal_repayment_party='Y') principal ON principal.project_id=fc.project_id WHERE fc.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND fqc.cf_item = 54 AND nvl(fqc.due_amount, 0) > nvl(fqc.billing_amount, 0)
UNION SELECT ccc.cashflow_id, ccc.contract_id, cc.contract_name, cc.contract_number, hbm.bp_name, hbm.bp_id, ccc.times, ccc.due_date, ccc.due_amount, ccc.received_amount, ccc.billing_principal, ccc.cf_item, hci.description AS cfItemDesc, hdc.description AS projectDesc, cc.document_category, cc.company_id, '保证金' as document_resource, '' as contract_content_number, (select arl.RECEIPT_LN_ID from ACR_RECEIPT_LN arl where arl.SOURCE_ID = ccc.CASHFLOW_ID and arl.SOURCE_TYPE = 'CON_CONTRACT') receipt_ln_id,
nvl((select '已打印' from ACR_RECEIPT_LN arl, ACR_RECEIPT_Hd arh where arl.RECEIPT_HD_ID = arh.RECEIPT_HD_ID and arl.SOURCE_ID = ccc.CASHFLOW_ID and arl.SOURCE_TYPE = 'CON_CONTRACT'),'未打印') as receipt_status_desc
FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc, con_contract cc, hls_cashflow_item hci, hls_bp_master hbm, hls_document_category hdc WHERE ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id AND hdc.document_category = cc.document_category AND cc.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND ccc.cf_direction = 'INFLOW' AND hbm.bp_id = cc.tenant_id AND hci.cf_item = ccc.cf_item AND hci.cf_type = ccc.cf_type AND ccc.cf_item = 51 AND ccc.write_off_flag = 'FULL' AND nvl(ccc.due_amount, 0) > nvl(ccc.billing_amount, 0) UNION SELECT fqc.quotation_cashflow_id AS cashflow_id, fc.contract_id, fc.contract_name, fc.contract_number, guarantee.bp_name, guarantee.bp_id, fqc.times, fqc.due_date, fqc.due_amount, fqc.received_amount, fqc.billing_amount AS billing_principal, fqc.cf_item, hci.description AS cfItemDesc, hdc.description AS projectDesc, fc.document_category, fc.company_id, '保证金' AS document_resource, ( SELECT f.approval_number FROM fct_project f WHERE f.project_id = fc.PROJECT_ID ) AS contract_content_number, ( SELECT arl.RECEIPT_LN_ID FROM ACR_RECEIPT_LN arl WHERE arl.SOURCE_ID = fqc.QUOTATION_CASHFLOW_ID AND arl.SOURCE_TYPE = 'FCT_CONTRACT') RECEIPT_LN_ID, nvl( ( SELECT '已打印' FROM ACR_RECEIPT_LN arl, ACR_RECEIPT_Hd arh WHERE arl.RECEIPT_HD_ID = arh.RECEIPT_HD_ID AND arl.SOURCE_ID = fqc.QUOTATION_CASHFLOW_ID AND arl.SOURCE_TYPE = 'FCT_CONTRACT'),'未打印') AS receipt_status_desc FROM fct_quotation_cashflow fqc JOIN fct_contract fc ON fqc.contract_id = fc.contract_id JOIN hls_cashflow_item hci ON hci.cf_item = fqc.cf_item AND hci.cf_type= fqc.cf_type JOIN hls_document_category hdc ON hdc.document_category = fc.document_category LEFT JOIN ( SELECT hbm.bp_id, hbm.bp_name, fpb.project_id FROM fct_project_bp fpb JOIN hls_bp_master hbm ON fpb.bp_id= hbm.bp_id WHERE fpb.repay_guarantee_party='Y') guarantee ON guarantee.project_id=fc.project_id WHERE fc.data_class = 'NORMAL' AND fqc.cf_direction = 'INFLOW' AND fqc.cf_item = 51 AND fqc.write_off_flag = 'FULL' AND nvl(fqc.due_amount, 0) > nvl(fqc.billing_amount, 0)
) tab
and tab.contract_name LIKE concat(concat('%',#{contractName}),'%')
and tab.contract_content_number LIKE concat(concat('%',#{contractContentNumber}),'%')
and trunc(tab.due_date) >= trunc(#{dueDateFrom})
and trunc(tab.due_date) <= trunc(#{dueDateTo})
and tab.bp_name LIKE concat(concat('%',#{bpName}),'%')
and tab.project_desc LIKE concat(concat('%',#{projectDesc}),'%')
and tab.company_id = #{companyId}
and tab.receipt_status_desc = #{receiptStatusDesc}

SELECT aih.invoice_hd_id,aih.invoice_status, (select SCVB.DESCRIPTION from SYS_CODE_B scb,SYS_CODE_VALUE_B scvb where scb.CODE_ID=SCVB.CODE_ID and SCB.CODE='VAT.INVOICE_KIND' and SCVB.value=aih.INVOICE_KIND) as INVOICE_KIND_DESC, ail.invoice_ln_id, aih.DOCUMENT_NUMBER, to_char(aih.INVOICE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as INVOICE_DATE_FORMAT , (select HBM.BP_code from HLS_BP_MASTER hbm where HBM.BP_ID=AIH.BP_ID) as bp_code, (select HBM.BP_NAME from HLS_BP_MASTER hbm where HBM.BP_ID=AIH.BP_ID) as bp_name, AIH.BP_TAX_REGISTRY_NUM, AIH.BP_ADDRESS_PHONE_NUM, AIH.BP_BANK_ACCOUNT, AIH.DESCRIPTION, NULL as NONE_1, NULL as NONE_2, NULL as NONE_3, NULL as NONE_4, NULL as NONE_5, NULL as NONE_6, NULL as NONE_7, NULL as NONE_8, NULL as NONE_9, AIL.PRODUCT_NAME, ail.SPECIFICATION, '期' as NONE_10, AIL.QUANTITY, AIL.TOTAL_AMOUNT, AIL.TAX_TYPE_RATE, AIL.TAX_AMOUNT, NULL as NONE_11, NULL as NONE_12, NULL as NONE_13, NULL as NONE_14, NULL as NONE_15, NULL as NONE_16, NULL as NONE_17, NULL as NONE_18, NULL as NONE_19, NULL as NONE_20, NULL as NONE_21, NULL as NONE_22, '12.0' as NONE_23, (case air.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_TYPE when 'FCT_CONTRACT' then '3060199' else '0' end) as tax_type_num, NULL as NONE_24, NULL as NONE_25, NULL as NONE_26, NULL as NONE_27 from acr_invoice_hd aih,acr_invoice_ln ail,acr_invoice_relationship air
aih.invoice_hd_id=ail.invoice_hd_id AND ail.invoice_ln_id=air.invoice_ln_id
AND to_char(#{invoiceDate},'yyyy-MM-dd') >= to_char(aih.invoice_date,'yyyy-MM-dd')
AND aih.invoice_kind IN
#{item}
and to_char(aih.invoice_date,'yyyy-MM-dd') between #{dateFrom} and #{dateTo}
AND air.source_document_type LIKE concat('%', #{sourceDocumentType}, '%')
-- GROUP BY aih.invoice_hd_id ORDER BY aih.invoice_date DESC

SELECT ccc.cashflow_id AS cashflowId, ccc.billing_amount as billingAmount, (case when hbm.taxpayer_type= 'SMALL_SCALE_TAXPAYER' and vipd.invoice_kind='0' then '增值税普通发票' else scvb.DESCRIPTION end ) as description, vipd.invoice_kind AS invoiceKind, fttc.tax_type_rate AS taxTypeRate, hbm.bp_id AS bpId, hbm.bp_name AS bpName, cc.document_type AS documentType, hbm.invoice_title AS invoiceTitle, vipd.taxable_service_name AS taxableServiceName, (case when hbm.three_certificates = 'Y' then hbm.REGISTER_CERT_NUM else hbm.tax_registry_num end ) AS bpTaxRegistryNum, hbm.invoice_bp_address_phone_num AS bpAddressPhoneNum, hbm.invoice_bp_bank_account AS bpBankAccount FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc, con_contract cc, vat_invoice_profile vip, vat_invoice_profile_dtl vipd, fnd_tax_type_code fttc, sys_code_b scb, sys_code_value_b scvb, hls_bp_master hbm WHERE ccc.cashflow_id = #{cashflowId} AND ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id --AND vip.invoice_profile = cc.billing_profile AND vip.company_id = cc.company_id AND vipd.invoice_profile = vip.invoice_profile AND (case when vipd.cf_item = 101 then 1 else vipd.cf_item end) = ccc.cf_item AND fttc.tax_type_code = vipd.tax_type_code AND fttc.company_id = cc.company_id AND scb.CODE = 'VAT.INVOICE_KIND' AND scb.CODE_ID = scvb.CODE_ID AND scvb.VALUE= vipd.invoice_kind AND cc.tenant_id = hbm.bp_id

select v.* from ( select DISTINCT arh.receipt_hd_id as receiptHdId, arh.document_number as documentNumber, arh.company_id as companyId, (select fc.company_full_name from fnd_company fc where fc.company_id = arh.company_id) as companyName, arh.bp_id, (select hbm.bp_name from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_id = arh.bp_id) as bpName, arh.receipt_date as receiptDate, arh.description as description, arh.total_amount as totalAmount, arl.source_id as sourceId, arl.source_type as sourceType from acr_receipt_hd arh, acr_receipt_ln arl where arh.receipt_hd_id = arl.receipt_hd_id ) v
1=1
and v.sourceType = 'CASHFLOW_PRINCIPAL'
and v.sourceType != 'CASHFLOW_PRINCIPAL'
and v.receiptDate between SUBDATE(sysdate,INTERVAL 7 day) and sysdate
and v.receiptDate between SUBDATE(sysdate,INTERVAL 1 MONTH) and sysdate
and v.receiptDate between SUBDATE(sysdate,INTERVAL 3 MONTH) and sysdate
v.receiptDate between sysdate and #{invoiceDate}
and (v.bpName like concat(concat('%',#{contractInfo}),'%'))
and v.totalAmount > #{totalAmountFrom}
and #{totalAmountTo} > v.totalAmount
order by v.receiptDate desc

select sum(t1.billing_amount) billing_amount, sum(t1.due_amount) due_amount, round(sum(t1.billing_amount)/sum(t1.due_amount),8) radio
from (select SUM(nvl(ccc.due_amount,0))due_amount, SUM(nvl(ccc.billing_amount,0))billing_amount from con_contract cc , con_contract_cashflow ccc where exists( select 1 from hls_system_event se where se.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID=cc.contract_id and se.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY='CON_CONTRACT' AND se.EVENT_CODE='CON_CONTRACT.INCEPT' ) and ccc.contract_id=cc.contract_id and ccc.cf_direction='INFLOW' and cc.company_id = #{companyId} and ( ( cc.business_type='LEASE' AND ccc.cf_item!=5) or ( cc.business_type='LEASEBACK' AND ccc.cf_item not in(1,2,5)) ) UNION select SUM(nvl(ccc.interest,0))due_amount, SUM(nvl(ccc.billing_interest,0))billing_amount from con_contract cc , con_contract_cashflow ccc where exists( select 1 from hls_system_event se where se.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID=cc.contract_id and se.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_CATEGORY='CON_CONTRACT' AND se.EVENT_CODE='CON_CONTRACT.INCEPT' ) and ccc.contract_id=cc.contract_id and ccc.cf_direction='INFLOW' and cc.company_id = #{companyId} and cc.business_type='LEASEBACK' AND ccc.cf_item in(1)) t1

SELECT hd.invoice_hd_id, hd.invoice_date, hd.invoice_kind, ( SELECT a.code_value_name FROM a WHERE a. CODE = 'VAT.INVOICE_KIND' AND a.code_value = hd.invoice_kind ) invoice_kind_desc, hd.bp_name, hd.bp_address_phone_num, hd.bp_bank_account, hd.net_amount, hd.tax_amount, hd.total_amount FROM acr_invoice_hd hd
hd.invoice_kind = #{invoiceKind}
and ( (#{netAmountFlag1}='1' and hd.net_amount <=500000 ) OR (#{netAmountFlag2}='1' and 1000000 >= hd.net_amount and hd.net_amount >= 500000 ) OR (#{netAmountFlag3}='1' and 1500000 >= hd.net_amount and hd.net_amount >= 1000000 ) OR (#{netAmountFlag4}='1' and 2000000 >= hd.net_amount and hd.net_amount >= 1500000 ) OR (#{netAmountFlag5}='1' and 2500000 >= hd.net_amount and hd.net_amount >= 2000000 ) OR (#{netAmountFlag6}='1' and 3000000 >= hd.net_amount and hd.net_amount >= 2500000 ) OR (#{netAmountFlag7}='1' and hd.net_amount >=3000000 ) )
and (hd.net_amount >=#{netAmountFrom})
and (hd.net_amount <=#{netAmountTo})
and ( (#{taxAmountFlag1}='1' and hd.tax_amount <= 50000 ) OR (#{taxAmountFlag2}='1' and 100000 >= hd.tax_amount and hd.tax_amount >= 50000 ) OR (#{taxAmountFlag3}='1' and 150000 >= hd.tax_amount and hd.tax_amount >= 100000 ) OR (#{taxAmountFlag4}='1' and 200000 >= hd.tax_amount and hd.tax_amount >= 150000 ) OR (#{taxAmountFlag1}='1' and 250000 >= hd.tax_amount and hd.tax_amount >= 200000 ) OR (#{taxAmountFlag1}='1' and 300000 >= hd.tax_amount and hd.tax_amount >= 250000 ) OR (#{taxAmountFlag1}='1' and hd.tax_amount >= 300000 )
)
and (hd.tax_amount >=#{taxAmountFrom})
and (hd.tax_amount<=#{taxAmountTo})
and ( (#{taxAmountTotalFlag1}='1' and hd.total_amount<=500000 ) OR (#{taxAmountTotalFlag2}='1' and 1000000 >= hd.total_amount and hd.total_amount >= 500000 ) OR (#{taxAmountTotalFlag3}='1' and 1500000 >= hd.total_amount and hd.total_amount >= 1000000 ) OR (#{taxAmountTotalFlag4}='1' and 2000000 >= hd.total_amount and hd.total_amount >= 1500000 ) OR (#{taxAmountTotalFlag5}='1' and 2500000 >= hd.total_amount and hd.total_amount >= 2000000 ) OR (#{taxAmountTotalFlag6}='1' and 3000000 >= hd.total_amount and hd.total_amount >= 2500000 ) OR (#{taxAmountTotalFlag7}='1' and hd.total_amount >= 3000000 ) )
and (hd.total_amount >=#{taxAmountTotalFrom})
and (hd.total_amount <=#{taxAmountTotalTo})
and hd.bp_name like concat(concat('%',#{organization1}),'%')
and hd.bp_bank_account like concat('%',#{purchasingUnit},'%')

SELECT v.* FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT arh.receipt_hd_id AS receiptHdId, arh.document_number AS documentNumber, arh.company_id AS companyId, ( SELECT fc.company_full_name FROM fnd_company fc WHERE fc.company_id = arh.company_id ) AS companyName, arh.bp_id, ( SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = arh.bp_id ) AS bpName, arh.receipt_date AS receiptDate, arh.description AS description, arh.total_amount AS totalAmount, arl.source_id AS sourceId, arl.source_type AS sourceType FROM acr_receipt_hd arh, acr_receipt_ln arl WHERE arh.receipt_hd_id = arl.receipt_hd_id ) v
1 = 1
and v.sourceType = #{documentType}
and v.receiptDate >= #{invoiceDateFrom}
and v.receiptDate <= #{invoiceDateTo}
and v.totalAmount <= 500000
and v.totalAmount > 500000 and v.totalAmount <=1000000
and v.totalAmount > 1000000 and v.totalAmount <=1500000
and v.totalAmount > 1500000 and v.totalAmount <2000000
and (v.totalAmount >=#{amountFrom})
and (v.totalAmount <=#{amountTo})
and v.bpName like concat(concat('%',#{organization1}),'%')

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ( SELECT v.meaning FROM v WHERE v. CODE = 'VAT.INVOICE_KIND' AND v.code_value = aih.invoice_kind ) AS invoice_kind , aih.company_id , aih.bp_name , aih.bp_tax_registry_num , aih.bp_address_phone_num , aih.bp_bank_account , aih.invoice_date , ail.product_name , ail.specification , ail.uom, nvl(ail.quantity , 0) AS quantity , nvl(ail.price , 0.00) AS price , nvl(ail.total_amount,0.00) AS total_amount, nvl(ail.net_amount,0.00) AS net_amount, ail.tax_type_rate , nvl(ail.tax_amount,0.00) AS tax_amount FROM acr_invoice_hd aih , acr_invoice_ln ail WHERE aih.invoice_hd_id = ail.invoice_hd_id AND aih.invoice_hd_id = #{invoiceHdId}
) tba LEFT JOIN( SELECT fc.company_id , fc.company_full_name , fc.Enterprise_unified_credit_code , fc.address , fc.phone , fc.Basic_account_bank , fc.Basic_account_number FROM fnd_company fc ) tbb ON tbb.company_id = tba.company_id and tba.company_id = #{companyId}

select arh.document_number as "documentNumber", arh.receipt_date as "receiptDate", hbm.bp_name as "bpName", fc.company_full_name as "companyName", arh.total_amount as "totalAmount" from acr_receipt_hd arh,hls_bp_master hbm,fnd_company fc where arh.receipt_hd_id = #{acrReceiptHdId} and arh.bp_id=hbm.bp_id and fc.company_id = arh.company_id

SELECT arl.amount, ccc.cashflow_id AS cashflowId, hci.description AS cfItemDesc FROM acr_receipt_hd arh, acr_receipt_ln arl, con_contract_cashflow ccc, con_contract cc, hls_cashflow_item hci WHERE arh.receipt_hd_id = #{acrReceiptHdId} AND arl.receipt_hd_id = arh.receipt_hd_id AND arl.source_id = ccc.cashflow_id AND ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id AND arl.source_type = cc.document_category AND hci.cf_item = ccc.cf_item AND hci.cf_type = ccc.cf_type union SELECT arl.amount, fqc.quotation_cashflow_id AS cashflowId, hci.description AS cfItemDesc FROM acr_receipt_hd arh, acr_receipt_ln arl, fct_quotation_cashflow fqc, fct_contract fc, hls_cashflow_item hci WHERE arh.receipt_hd_id = #{acrReceiptHdId} AND arl.receipt_hd_id = arh.receipt_hd_id AND arl.source_id = fqc.quotation_cashflow_id AND fqc.contract_id = fc.contract_id AND arl.source_type = fc.document_category AND hci.cf_item = fqc.cf_item AND hci.cf_type = fqc.cf_type

SELECT hbm.bp_id, hbm.bp_name, hbm.invoice_title, ( CASE hbm.three_certificates WHEN 'Y' THEN hbm.register_cert_num WHEN 'N' THEN hbm.tax_registry_num END ) AS bpTaxRegistryNum, hbm.invoice_bp_address_phone_num AS bpAddressPhoneNum, hbm.invoice_bp_bank_account AS bpBankAccount FROM fct_project_bp fpp, hls_bp_master hbm WHERE fpp.project_id = ( SELECT project_id FROM fct_contract fc WHERE fc.contract_id = #{contractId} ) AND fpp.bp_id = hbm.bp_id

SELECT AIH.INVOICE_HD_ID, AIH.INVOICE_KIND, AIH.DOCUMENT_NUMBER, AIH.INVOICE_DATE, AIH.BP_ID, AIH.BP_NAME, AIH.BP_TAX_REGISTRY_NUM, AIH.BP_ADDRESS_PHONE_NUM, AIH.BP_BANK_ACCOUNT, AIH.DESCRIPTION, AIL.INVOICE_LN_ID, AIL.PRODUCT_NAME, AIL.QUANTITY, AIL.TOTAL_AMOUNT, AIL.TAX_TYPE_RATE, AIL.TAX_AMOUNT, RELA.INVOICE_RELATION_ID, RELA.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_ID, RELA.SOURCE_DOCUMENT_TYPE FROM ACR_INVOICE_HD AIH, ACR_INVOICE_LN AIL, ACR_INVOICE_RELATIONSHIP RELA
AIH.INVOICE_HD_ID=AIL.INVOICE_HD_ID AND RELA.INVOICE_LN_ID=AIL.INVOICE_LN_ID
AND to_days(#{invoiceDate}) >= to_days(AIH.invoice_date)
AND AIH.invoice_kind IN
#{item}
and to_days(AIH.invoice_date) between to_days(#{dateFrom}) and to_days(#{dateTo})
AND RELA.source_document_type LIKE concat('%', #{sourceDocumentType}, '%')
mapper.update: update acr_invoice_hd a set a.handover_status = 'TRANSFERING' , a.handover_person = #{handoverPerson} where a.invoice_hd_id=#{invoiceHdId}
update acr_invoice_hd a set a.handover_status = 'TRANSFER_END' ,a.review_person = #{reviewPerson} where a.invoice_hd_id=#{invoiceHdId}
mapper.select:
select aih.invoice_hd_id,aih.document_number,aih.billing_way,aih.invoice_code,aih.invoice_date, aih.bp_name,aih.bp_tax_registry_num,aih.bp_address_phone_num,aih.bp_bank_account,aih.net_amount, aih.invoice_status,aih.receipt_flag,aih.red_invoice_notice,aih.invoice_period, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'VAT.INVOICE_KIND' AND aih.invoice_kind = v.code_value ) invoice_kind_n, ( SELECT hbm.bp_name FROM hls_bp_master hbm WHERE hbm.bp_id = aih.bp_id ) bp_id_n, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'VAT.BILLING_WAY' AND aih.billing_way = v.code_value ) billing_way_n, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'VAT.INVOICE_STATUS' AND aih.invoice_status = v.code_value ) invoice_status_n, aih.confirm_status, ( SELECT v.meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v. CODE = 'VAT.INVOICE_CONFIRM_STATUS' AND aih.confirm_status = v.code_value ) confirm_status_n, ( SELECT su.user_name FROM sys_user su WHERE su.user_id = aih.created_by ) created_by_n, ( SELECT su.user_name FROM sys_user su WHERE su.user_id = aih.confirmed_by ) confirmed_by_n from acr_invoice_hd aih
and aih.invoice_status = 'NEW' and aih.reversed_flag = 'N'
and ( aih.document_number like concat('%',concat(#{queryInfo},'%')) or aih.billing_way like concat('%',concat(#{queryInfo},'%')) or aih.invoice_code like concat('%',concat(#{queryInfo},'%')) or ( exists( select 1 from hls_bp_master hbm where hbm.bp_name like concat('%',concat(#{queryInfo},'%')) and hbm.bp_id = aih.bp_id ) ) or aih.bp_name like concat('%',concat(#{queryInfo},'%')) )
order by aih.invoice_date desc

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ail.invoice_ln_id source_document_id, ail.document_number, ( SELECT a.USER_ID FROM sys_user s, sys_user_allocation a, fnd_employee e, fnd_employee_assigns fa, FND_ORG_POSITION p WHERE s.user_id = a.user_id AND a.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = fa.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID AND fa.EMPLOYEE_ID = e.EMPLOYEE_ID AND fa.position_id = p.position_id AND p.POSITION_CODE = 'A0550' ) HANDOVER_PERSON, (SELECT DISTINCT fou.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fou, prj_project pp
WHERE fou.unit_id = pp.host_unit_id
and pp.project_id=ail.contract_id) AS HOST_PARTMENT, (SELECT DISTINCT su.description FROM sys_user su,
prj_project pp
WHERE su.user_id = pp.host_project_manager
and pp.project_id=ail.contract_id) AS HOST_MANAGER, ( SELECT cc.contract_number FROM prj_project cc WHERE cc.project_id = ail.contract_id ) contract_number, AIL.RECORD_DATE INVOICE_DATE, AIL.invoice_code INVOICE_CODE, AIL.invoice_number INVOICE_NUMBER, AIL.BP_NAME, ail.total_amount, AIL.TAX_AMOUNT, ( CASE
WHEN ail.tax_type_rate = 0 THEN '0' WHEN ail.tax_type_rate = 0.03 THEN '3' WHEN ail.tax_type_rate = 0.05 THEN '5' WHEN ail.tax_type_rate = 0.09 THEN '9' WHEN ail.tax_type_rate = 0.13 THEN '13' WHEN ail.tax_type_rate = 0.06 THEN '6' END ) TAX_TYPE_RATE, AIL.invoice_status HANDOVER_STATUS, ail.CREATED_BY
FROM acp_invoice_ln ail WHERE AIL.INVOICE_STATUS = 'IMPORTED' UNION SELECT aih.invoice_hd_id source_document_id, aih.document_number, ( SELECT DISTINCT su.user_id FROM sys_user su, con_contract_cashflow ccc, con_contract cc, prj_project pp, acr_invoice_ln ail, acr_invoice_ln_dt aid WHERE su.user_id = pp.host_project_manager AND aih.invoice_hd_id = ail.invoice_hd_id AND ail.invoice_ln_id = aid.invoice_ln_id AND ccc.cashflow_id = aid.cashflow_id AND ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id AND pp.project_id = cc.project_id ) AS HANDOVER_PERSON, ( SELECT DISTINCT fou.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fou, con_contract_cashflow ccc, con_contract cc, prj_project pp, acr_invoice_ln ail, acr_invoice_ln_dt aid WHERE fou.unit_id = pp.host_unit_id AND aih.invoice_hd_id = ail.invoice_hd_id AND ail.invoice_ln_id = aid.invoice_ln_id AND ccc.cashflow_id = aid.cashflow_id AND ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id AND pp.project_id = cc.project_id ) AS HOST_PARTMENT, ( SELECT DISTINCT su.description FROM sys_user su, con_contract_cashflow ccc, con_contract cc, prj_project pp, acr_invoice_ln ail, acr_invoice_ln_dt aid WHERE su.user_id = pp.host_project_manager AND aih.invoice_hd_id = ail.invoice_hd_id AND ail.invoice_ln_id = aid.invoice_ln_id AND ccc.cashflow_id = aid.cashflow_id AND ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id AND pp.project_id = cc.project_id ) AS HOST_MANAGER, ( SELECT DISTINCT wm_concat( cc.contract_number) FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc, con_contract cc, acr_invoice_ln ail, acr_invoice_ln_dt aid WHERE ccc.cashflow_id = aid.cashflow_id AND aih.invoice_hd_id = ail.invoice_hd_id AND ail.invoice_ln_id = aid.invoice_ln_id AND ccc.contract_id = cc.contract_id ) contract_number, aih.invoice_date, aih.INVOICE_CODE, aih.INVOICE_NUMBER, aih.bp_name, aih.total_amount, aih.tax_amount, ( SELECT DISTINCT MAX( ail.tax_type_rate ) FROM acr_invoice_ln ail WHERE ail.invoice_hd_id = aih.invoice_hd_id ) AS tax_type_rate, CASE
WHEN aih.handover_status IS NULL THEN 'NOT_TRANSFER' ELSE aih.handover_status END AS handover_status, aih.CREATED_BY FROM acr_invoice_hd aih WHERE aih.invoice_status IN ( 'IMPORTED' ) AND aih.reversed_flag = 'N' ) tt WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INVOICE_HANDOVER_APPLICATION t1 WHERE t1.DOCUMENT_ID = tt.source_document_id )
